mcq_fix.s: Which Telugu poet is known by the title 'Abhinava Nannaya'?
mcq_fix.why: odd meta wording about 'commission's key'; y00a6c6b993a

patterns: APPSC asks direct work-author / song-book one-liners: 'Desamante matti kadoi' in Mutyala Saralu, Gabbilam = Jashuva, Japaneeyamu = Sriram Veerabrahmam.
Titles of poets (Abhinava Nannaya, Kavi Samrat, Telugu Lenka, Madhurakavi) are a recurring G2 shape.
First Telugu Jnanpith (Viswanatha, Ramayana Kalpavrikshamu) and 4-item work-author matches (G2 2008, 2025).
App goes deeper into proscribed literature and Garimella biography (jail terms, cyclostyling) than PYQs show.
